subject: Transition plan & security gate cadence for MAP (SOC2 / SIG / DPA)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@ledgercorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Transition plan & security gate cadence for MAP (SOC2 / SIG / DPA)

Asha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. I wanted to put a concrete MAP-style timeline and security gate cadence on your radar so we can align expectations with procurement and engineering. High-level goals: pilot Redwood hosted inference in staging by late June, complete security intake and contract underwriter checks in parallel, and have a signed DPA before production.

Proposed security/compliance checkpoints (draft):
- SIG/CAIQ: Ledger completes questionnaire (we'll provide the spreadsheet) — target Jun 8
- SOC 2: Redwood to provide Type II PDF + 1‑pager control scope (we'll deliver Jun 4)
- DPA: Legal redline roundtrip — review by Jun 10, target sign by Jun 18
- Data retention annex: confirm retention windows (logs/inputs/embeddings) and residency for EU data — finalize Jun 12
- Evidence intake & staging test: security team to validate staging connectivity and evidence access — target Jun 22

I attached an initial MAP spreadsheet (proposed_map_v1.xlsx) and a short SOC2 summary for your reviewers. Would you confirm: 1) who on your side owns the SIG response (name/email), and 2) whether you have any non‑standard retention requirements beyond typical 3–7 year archival windows?

If those milestones look ok I can circulate an updated MAP with firm dates and owners and loop in our Legal (Kimberly) for the DPA redline.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0132

Attachments: proposed_map_v1.xlsx, redwood_soc2_onepager.pdf

From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@ledgercorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@ledgercorp.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Transition plan & security gate cadence for MAP (SOC2 / SIG / DPA)

Ben —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers and a couple items from our side:

1) SIG/CAIQ ownership: I will coordinate the SIG responses but please expect to hear from our SecOps analyst (sec-ops@ledgercorp.com) with a few clarifying questions as they work through the spreadsheet. I attached our completed baseline SIG/CAIQ matrix — some fields still need vendor confirmation.

2) SOC2 artifacts: We require a Type II report + control narratives for services in scope. If you can provide the OnePager now, please also send the full control mapping by EOD Friday (Jun 4). In practice our InfoSec prefers a scoped SOC2 that highlights production inference runtime, key management, and logging/monitoring controls — that will speed acceptance.

3) Data retention / residency: LedgerCorp has two constraints to flag now — (a) logs and audit traces for payment-related workflows must be retained for 7 years in encrypted form, (b) any EU‑sourced user PII must remain in EU regions only. For the MAP we need a short data retention annex in the DPA that is explicit about retention windows and cross‑border processing. I attached our current retention policy excerpt.

4) DPA: Our Legal has uploaded a clean DPA to DocuSign with a few target redlines. I'll share the DocuSign link once our counsel confirms. Expect one commercial redline around indemnity scope; we can handle technical DPA carveouts in parallel.

Next steps we propose from LedgerCorp:
- We will complete the SIG fields that are purely administrative and highlight technical questions back to you by Jun 3.
- SecOps can do a short staging access run on Jun 20/21; pick a half‑day window and we'll book it.

Thanks — looking forward to a tight MAP.

—
Asha Rao
Head of Security Operations | LedgerCorp
asha.rao@ledgercorp.com

Attachments: SIG_CAIX_completed.xlsx, ledger_retention_policy_v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Transition plan & security gate cadence for MAP (SOC2 / SIG / DPA)

Asha —

Great — thanks for the detail and for the SIG doc. Confirming Redwood will:
- Deliver full SOC2 Type II PDF + a control mapping document focused on production inference, key management, and logging by EOD Jun 4 (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf).
- Update the MAP spreadsheet with firm milestone dates and named owners (attached proposed_map_v2.xlsx).
- Draft a DPA data retention annex that explicitly states: logs/audit traces retention up to 7 years (encrypted at rest), and EU residency options for PII. We'll route that to Kimberly for the first redline pass; Kimberly, can you please review the DPA once we have LedgerCorp's DocuSign redlines?

Proposed MAP milestone recap (draft):
- Jun 3: Ledger sec team returns SIG clarifications to Redwood
- Jun 4: Redwood delivers SOC2 artifacts and control mapping
- Jun 10: Legal redline roundtrip (initial comments from both sides)
- Jun 12: Agree final data retention annex language
- Jun 18: Target DPA signature
- Jun 22–24: Staging evidence run with SecOps (booked by Ledger)
- Jun 28: Production pilot gating (subject to signed DPA and successful staging validation)

If that looks good to you I'll (1) upload the v2 MAP to the shared Drive, (2) attach SOC2 artifacts to the HubSpot deal (LDG-5127), and (3) ask Kimberly to coordinate with your counsel on the DPA redlines.

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0132
